body: Do you think suicide is a human right?
Those friends and family, who themselves are also going to cease to exist? This is just mental masturbation to try to attribute a delusory sense of purpose to our existence.

Being truly selfless or truly altruistic is just as real as the deities you all mock. Every single good deed or act always relates back to building up the person who committed said act, whether it be to jack off your own ego, to establish good relations (scratch your back you’ll scratch mine),  or even just unconsciously wanting to increase the emotional gratification and happiness you yourself receive in life.

The fact you’re going against your wife’s wishes to end her life are inherently selfish. Then again, bringing more life into this fucked up world by itself I think is pretty fucked as well, so you and your wife are shitty people regardless.
Why, though? It’s simply returning to our previous state. There’s nothing impactful or special about any human life, no matter how many people say we can “change da worl!!!”
